files.content:
name: ci

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: erlef/setup-beam@54075bcc5e249e4758d363f27d099f55d843f124 # v1
        with:
          otp-version: '27.3'
          rebar3-version: '3.24.0'
          gleam-version: '1.18.0'
      - name: Compile
        run: rebar3 compile
      - name: Verify reviewed dependency lock is unchanged
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -f rebar.lock
          git diff --exit-code -- rebar.lock
      - name: EUnit
        run: rebar3 eunit
      - name: Xref
        run: rebar3 xref
      - name: Prove Hosted Gleam ABI fixture
        run: |
          cd test/fixtures/hosted_abi
          gleam build
          beam_dir="$(dirname "$(find build -type f -name worker.beam -print -quit)")"
          test -n "$beam_dir"
          erl -noshell -pa "$beam_dir" -eval '
            Request = {request, <<"POST">>, <<"/abi">>,
                       [{<<"content-type">>, <<"application/octet-stream">>}],
                       <<0,1,2>>},
            Context = {context,
                       {cluster_capability, <<"cluster">>},
                       {some, {http_capability, <<"http">>}},
                       {log_capability, <<"log">>},
                       none,
                       123},
            {response, 201, Headers, <<0,1,2>>} = worker:handle(Request, Context),
            true = lists:member({<<"x-method">>, <<"POST">>}, Headers),
            true = lists:member({<<"x-url">>, <<"/abi">>}, Headers),
            true = lists:member({<<"x-capabilities">>, <<"http-only">>}, Headers),
            true = lists:member({<<"x-deadline">>, <<"123">>}, Headers),
            halt(0).'
      - name: Build self-contained OTP release
        run: rebar3 release
      - name: Smoke self-contained release files
        run: |
          rel=_build/default/rel/bmscl_supervisor
          test -x "$rel/bin/bmscl_supervisor"
          test -f "$rel/releases/0.1.0/start.boot"
          test -n "$(find "$rel" -path '*/erts-*/bin/beam.smp' -type f -print -quit)"

{erl_opts, [debug_info, warn_unused_import, warn_unused_vars]}.

{deps, [
    {jsx, "3.1.0"},
    {eredis, "1.7.1"},
    %% Trusted provider ingress only. Tenant code never imports Cowboy.
    %% Cowboy's Hex metadata expresses cowlib ranges that Rebar3 3.24 rejects.
    %% Pin the reviewed 2.14.2 commit directly; rebar.lock pins the full transitive graph.
    {cowboy, ".*", {git, "https://github.com/ninenines/cowboy",
                     {ref, "495e74ada88d0876d7e438d53f11af767a9cdcc4"}}}
]}.

{eunit_opts, [verbose]}.
{xref_checks, [undefined_function_calls, undefined_functions, locals_not_used]}.

%% Production guest images consume a self-contained release rather than source
%% trees or a host-installed Erlang runtime. No distributed node name is set;
%% the shared-hosting guest is intentionally non-distributed and reached only
%% through the loopback guest-control bridge.
{relx, [
    {release, {bmscl_supervisor, "0.1.0"}, [bmscl_supervisor, sasl]},
    {dev_mode, false},
    {include_erts, true},
    {extended_start_script, true}
]}.
